title: DAO prefix authorization: origin_not_pinned shadows delegation reasons (6 red tests)
description: python/tests/rpl/test_dao_prefix_authorization.py: 6 tests fail with AssertionError 'origin_not_pinned' where the expected reason is delegation_expired / delegate_mismatch / target_mismatch / unsupported_transit. The DAO manager's origin-pin check fires before the delegation-specific validation, so the more informative delegation failure reason is shadowed. Affects: test_dao_prefix_authorization_allow_deny_matrix[self_host_route_allowed, foreign_host_route_rejected], test_delegated_foreign_host_route_allowed_after_seeding, test_delegation_is_bound_to_the_delegated_origin, test_expired_delegation_is_rejected_without_mutation, test_external_transit_rejected_without_mutation. Found while verifying yhbl (TxQueue) was already fixed; test_rpl_control_link_signatures.py passes.
